about: ADR 0013 / 0015 calibration: per family, summaries (n, min, p5, median, p95, max) of each measure. engineRekey: the new engine (CPU, equal to WebGPU at L1) drawing v21's replayed variation and re-keying its placement stream, 3 keys per configuration (a full re-draw). negativeControls: one structural or pen change per control, re-keyed, against the base, with how many applicable configurations the thresholds caught. v21Reroll: v21 at az and az + 0.3° where its stipple re-rolled (a partial re-draw).
